sources.title: UNetFormer | WangLibo1995/GeoSeg | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: UNetFormer is a semantic segmentation model in the GeoSeg toolkit that combines the encoder-decoder structure of U-Net with transformer-based attention mechanisms. It is specifically designed for remote sensing image segmentation tasks and has been validated on multiple geospatial datasets including Vaihingen, Potsdam, UAVid, and LoveDA.
